title: One motion prompt (one JSON object per line of prompts_motion.jsonl). Action only: no body description.

text.description: the prompt exactly as given to the system; English; describes the motion only

action.description: free text, e.g. walk, wave, backflip

applies_to.description: which panel rigs the motion is applied to

adaptation_test.description: true: an action that exists in the data only for two-leg bodies, asked for on a four-leg rig

n_steps.description: number of sequential actions in the prompt

duration_hint_s.description: expected duration in seconds if the prompt implies one

split.description: dev: tune the judge prompt and thresholds; test: touched once per system version
